There are overall 32 teams that compete for the title every year.

Sofascore tracks live football scores and AFC Champions League Two table, results, statistics and top scorers.

The top 1 team qualifies for the AFC Champion League main tournament or preliminary qualifications.

The top scorers in the last season of AFC Champions League Two AFC Champions League Two 25/26 season were Trent Buhagiar.Last season top scorer is Trent Buhagiar with 8 goals.

Who won the first AFC Champions League Two?

Al-Jaish won the first AFC Champions League Two.

Which team is the current titleholder in AFC Champions League Two?

The current titleholder in AFC Champions League Two is Gamba Osaka.

How many goals are scored on average in AFC Champions League Two in AFC Champions League Two 26/27?

The average number of goals in AFC Champions League Two is 2.88.

When does the AFC Champions League Two start and when does it finish?

The AFC Champions League Two usually starts in August and ends in May.

How many groups are there in AFC Champions League Two competition?

The teams in AFC Champions League Two are placed in 30 groups.
